title: Phone connection: the four screens, redrawn

steps.path: The strip at the top of a conversation while the Android app is reconnecting
steps.headline: Use this phone only is now an outlined button on its own line, so the status line stays on one line.
steps.changed: The button had no outline and sat beside the words. It now spans the strip under them.
steps.notice: The title and the hint each fit on one line at phone width, and the button looks pressable.
steps.risk: The strip is a little taller on Android. Phone browsers do not get this button, so theirs is unchanged.

steps.path: The screen the Android app shows on launch while it connects to your computer
steps.headline: The connecting screen now wears setup's look: lavender, the youcoded name, and the app's spinner beside Connecting to Home PC.
steps.changed: Plain bold YouCoded Remote over grey words became the brand screen from first-time setup.
steps.notice: Opening the app, connecting, and the screens below all look like one branded start-up.
steps.risk: It stays lavender in every theme, like setup. Your chosen theme starts once the conversation opens.

steps.path: The same launch screen when the computer cannot be reached
steps.headline: Can't reach Home PC is now one white card: a heading, a line, Try again filled and Use this phone only outlined.
steps.changed: Loose centred lines and a borderless button became one card. Try now is renamed Try again, the app's word everywhere.
steps.notice: The card says it keeps trying by itself, and the way out is a real button.
steps.risk: While a retry runs, the heading reads Trying to connect and Try again greys out for a moment.

steps.path: The web version on a phone or tablet, after another tab of the same browser took over
steps.headline: A tab another tab took over now shows one card, Open in another tab, with only a Reload this tab button.
steps.changed: The password box and Connect are gone from this screen; a password cannot fix it. The same card shows when the page is older than the computer's YouCoded.
steps.notice: One clear button. Reloading signs back in with no typing.
steps.risk: Reloading this tab takes the connection back from the other tab, which then shows this same card.

steps.path: The sign-in page of the web version, when a password is needed
steps.headline: The password screen gets the same look: a card titled Connect to your computer, the box named above it, Connect in the brand gradient.
steps.changed: It was YouCoded Remote in plain bold, a bare box and a button on the theme's colours. Not on the last deck; changed to match the others.
steps.notice: Every screen before the app now looks the same. A wrong password still shows its message under the box.
steps.risk: Like setup, it is lavender in every theme, so it no longer matches a dark theme you picked on the computer.
